facts.text: Channel 3 news, live from the sewers
facts.why: April reports from the surface for Channel 3 and sits in the turtles' sewer home as a guest, but she never broadcasts live from the sewers.

facts.text: April O'Neil, reporting live from the sewer
facts.why: April signs off as O'Neil of Channel Three Eyewitness News from above ground. She is brought to the sewer as a guest and never reports from there.
facts.fix: April O'Neil, Channel Three Eyewitness News

vibe.verdict: A good corner-grate pizza place with the Domino's style delivery gag, but the film's story beats barely appear.
